notes.title: STAMP - WHAT'S NEXT?
notes.content:
Hi guys,
Main dev of STAMP here from ReverseGames we would like to know your feedback and feeling about the game. We hope that we can build future of our game together. So we just want to know what do you think about our game and what we should change to get better gameplay? We are open for yours suggestions. As a team we were thinking about our plans and we have few ways to see our future.

First plan:
-First update game balance (zombies health, zombie speed, spawn rate, gun balance, money balance etc.).
-Second update polish up game (we will try to exlude all bugs, re-code some scripts that are responsible for AI zombie and spawns.
-Third update new content (new maps, bosses, more missions, more weapons, more easter eggs etc.).

Second plan:
-First update game balance (zombies health, speed, spawn rate, gun balance, money balance etc.).
-Second update polish up game (we will try to exlude all bugs, re-code some scripts that are responsible for AI zombie and spawns.
-Third update co-op (we will try to implement multiplayer mode to our game so you can have fun playing with your friends)
-Fourth update new content (new maps, bosses, more missions, more weapons, more easter eggs etc.).

Let us know what do you think about our plans and future of our game in the comments :)

Best regards,
ReverseGames Team.

notes.title: STAMP DEMO - NEXT STEAM FESTIVAL LIVE STREAM
notes.content:
"STAMP" is a very exciting shooter where your main job is to KILL zombies and complete the main task. Meanwhile you have a lot of stuff to try like perks, new weapons or side quests. We can play in a few diffrent ways, you can just speedrun your task and complete the mission, but you can also play it slowly pick-up drops from zombie which will make your better, attempt on finding Easter-Egg's, upgrade your equipment by perks or by upgrade your weapon, use a items that will make your gameplay simplier or just make more advantages on killing zombies from available items in game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41608671/92cc7334eb486934ab83030455d8b154d818ee1f.png[/img]

notes.title: STAMP (Small Demo Update)
notes.content:
[h1][b]STAMP (Small Demo Update)[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]22.02.2022[/b][/h2]

[h3]Patch notes:[/h3]
-Spawn zombies are changed (more zombies per round and also they spawn faster now)
-Zombie can no longer spawn before cutscene
-Increased zombie HP
-Improved manual button textures
-Game balance
-Gun balance
-Small changes in menu
-Improved brightness and VSYNC option
-The time between rounds has been increased by an additional 3 seconds
-Added collisions of some objects on the map
-Dialogues now appear after cutscene
-C4 can no longer be picked up before the mission appear
-Price of ak47 now appears
-And more small changes that we didn't annouce

[h1]See you soon on next livestream[/h1]
